contradictions: the shipped suspend ran, but the kernel's available pages did not rise by at least half of the resident drop
the process gave up resident bytes that the kernel never returned to the free/inactive pool

rules.A1: reference_release + resource_reclaim + lifecycle_suspend recorded by the shipped role
rules.A2: footprint >= 1 GiB and alive on every pre-window sample
rules.A3: post-window footprint <= 30% of peak and drop >= 1 GiB
rules.A5: kernel (free+inactive) max inside the settle window rises >= 50% of the drop
rules.A7: rusage ok on every post-window sample AND the app wrote its evidence file after the window
rules.A9: app-reported drop within 20% of the kernel-measured drop

what_this_is_not: not a process exit (the exit teardown is measured separately and excluded), not an RSS comparison, and not a call into a release API: the kernel's own page counters move while the process stays alive.
